# OMNIA

OMNIA V9 policy-evidence-execution admission kernel, Cedar policy, V7 state and gap ledger, OMNIA lineage X10-X512M.

> Navigation aid, not evidence. A listed file exists; that says nothing about whether it runs, is deployed, or has produced any external result.

**160 files** match this project by name. [All projects](README.md) · [Master index](../../REPOSITORY_INDEX.md)

Before present-tense claims, also check `docs/CURRENT_HANDOFF.json` and `docs/CURRENT_SYSTEM_STATE.md`; dated documents describe their date, not today.

## Understanding

**What it is.** The admission kernel between intelligence and consequence: creates and verifies action intents, evidence, approvals and execution receipts, answers allow, review or deny, and provides a provider-neutral effect adapter contract and Cedar policy. Carries the OMNIA lineage X10 to V9 and the V7 mission graph.

**What you use it for.** The final gate on any consequential action. About a third of its 52 modules are wired.

- [`artifacts/v7/baselines.json`](../../artifacts/v7/baselines.json) — V7 baselines with evidence pointers, contradictions and uncertainty at a source SHA. · **Use:** baseline measurements for V7 evaluation epochs
- [`artifacts/v7/claim-evidence-registry.json`](../../artifacts/v7/claim-evidence-registry.json) — Registry linking directives/claims to guards and evidence, noting guards registered but never run and term-overlap linkage limits. · **Use:** audit which claims have real evidence behind them
- [`artifacts/v7/evaluation-epoch.json`](../../artifacts/v7/evaluation-epoch.json) — V7 evaluation epoch with metrics, deltas from previous epoch and growth class. · **Use:** measure improvement between evaluation epochs
- [`artifacts/v7/final-frontier-state.json`](../../artifacts/v7/final-frontier-state.json) — V7 final frontier state: completion law, remaining blockers, mode, termination law and not-claimed list. · **Use:** state where the V7 mission terminates
- [`artifacts/v7/frontier-checkpoint.json`](../../artifacts/v7/frontier-checkpoint.json) — V7 frontier checkpoint: resume point, gap summary with EXTERNAL_BLOCKED/FOUNDER_ONLY statuses, canonical V9 carrier incomplete, deployment. · **Use:** resume the V7 frontier in a new session
- [`artifacts/v7/gap-ledger.json`](../../artifacts/v7/gap-ledger.json) — Computed gap ledger: V9 not reconstructable, precedence law conflicts founder-only, expired deployment evidence, unguarded external-effect directives, branch-only work. · **Use:** list remaining gaps and who can close them
- [`artifacts/v7/live-truth.json`](../../artifacts/v7/live-truth.json) — V7 live truth snapshot of git, canon, deployment and canonical V9 state, stale by default. · **Use:** current-truth read for V7 decisions
- [`artifacts/v7/mission-dag.json`](../../artifacts/v7/mission-dag.json) — Mission DAG of V7 gaps as nodes/edges (V9 reconstruction, no cleared payment, no model provider configured). · **Use:** order remaining V7 missions by dependency
- [`artifacts/v7/proof-obligations.json`](../../artifacts/v7/proof-obligations.json) — Large table of proof obligations derived from the constitution with counts of outstanding code-dischargeable items. · **Use:** know which constitutional obligations code can still discharge
- [`artifacts/v7/resource-allocation.json`](../../artifacts/v7/resource-allocation.json) — V7 resource allocation: allocated vs waiting work with basis and explanation why not expected-value ranked. · **Use:** allocate effort across V7 missions
- [`config/omnia-v9/constitution-sources.json`](../../config/omnia-v9/constitution-sources.json) — OMNIA V9 constitution source set (Knowledge Graph, Decision Engine, Learning Engine, Core Data Model) with precedence rules. · **Use:** inputs compiled into OMNIA V9 policy
- [`config/omnia-v9/policy-projection.json`](../../config/omnia-v9/policy-projection.json) — OMNIA V9 policy projection: rules, resolver facts and Cedar runtime contract. · **Use:** project constitution into Cedar admission policy
- [`migrations/005_omnia_v9_proof_store.sql`](../../migrations/005_omnia_v9_proof_store.sql) — Migration creating OMNIA V9 content-addressed object and revocation tables · **Use:** proof store for OMNIA V9 kernel
- [`migrations/006_omnia_v9_execution_receipt_uniqueness.sql`](../../migrations/006_omnia_v9_execution_receipt_uniqueness.sql) — Migration binding one execution receipt per reservation with pre-effect digests · **Use:** enforce receipt uniqueness in OMNIA V9
- [`migrations/007_omnia_v9_authorization_bound_receipts.sql`](../../migrations/007_omnia_v9_authorization_bound_receipts.sql) — Migration linking execution receipts to authorization decisions, policy and constitution digests · **Use:** authorization-bound receipts for OMNIA V9
- [`migrations/008_omnia_v9_authority_transition_ledger.sql`](../../migrations/008_omnia_v9_authority_transition_ledger.sql) — Migration creating hash-chained OMNIA V9 authority transition event ledger · **Use:** append-only authority state history
- [`migrations/009_omnia_v9_shadow_approval_registry.sql`](../../migrations/009_omnia_v9_shadow_approval_registry.sql) — Migration for shadow-only approval registry that structurally cannot grant authority · **Use:** restrict approvals to reality-shadow validation
- [`migrations/010_omnia_v9_canary_null_receipts.sql`](../../migrations/010_omnia_v9_canary_null_receipts.sql) — Migration for null-sink canary receipts with one receipt per reservation · **Use:** support zero-consequence canary drills
- [`migrations/011_omnia_v9_external_effect_executions.sql`](../../migrations/011_omnia_v9_external_effect_executions.sql) — Migration for OMNIA V9 external-effect execution objects and hash-chained transitions for crash recovery · **Use:** durable external effect execution tracking
- [`policy/omnia-v9/authorization.cedar`](../../policy/omnia-v9/authorization.cedar) — Cedar authorization policy forbidding execution unless authority, identity, evidence, policy and constitution are resolved, and learning-origin sovereignty changes. · **Use:** Executable projection of OMNIA V9 constitutional gate rules.
